title: Add ceiling/weighting to BuildClusters
description:
## G-8 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

BuildClusters groups nodes by exact-match, non-colon tags shared by more than one node, with no weighting or size cap. A broadly-applied tag (sprint label, generic category tag) becomes a giant "cluster" as large as any meaningful grouping. Every node can belong to arbitrarily many overlapping clusters.

### Detailed Steps
1. As a cheap first pass: exclude tags above a configurable member-count ceiling from cluster formation, and/or weight cluster membership by inverse tag frequency (rare shared tags more informative than common ones — TF-IDF intuition)
2. As a follow-up (lower confidence): evaluate whether real community detection (label propagation over Phase 2 typed-edge graph, not just tag co-occurrence) is worth the added complexity

### Test Plan
- Tag shared by 80% of fixture corpus does NOT produce a "cluster" once ceiling is applied
- Tag shared by 3 semantically-related records does produce a cluster
